title: CAWS turn log (turn-NNN.json) payload, schema_version 2
$comment: Governing spec: CAWS-HARNESS-TELEMETRY-ADAPTER-001. Producer contract for the operational cache at .caws/sessions/<session-id>/turn-NNN.json: it validates what telemetry producers (vendored renderers and per-harness adapters) write; no kernel authority path reads turn logs (cache-not-authority). ADDITIVE-ONLY FROM V2: optional fields may be added by a producing renderer; required fields, the status enum, and existing field shapes may only change through a new schema_version document, and unknown schema_version values are rejected, never coerced. Timeline items are polymorphic per 'kind' — this contract pins the structural core (kind, ts, provenance) and leaves per-kind detail to the producing renderer so the contract does not churn with every renderer revision. Required top-level keys are the intersection observed across real v2 files: some producers omit 'context' (and with it 'ended_by'/'hook_contexts') for degraded turns.

schema_version.description: Wire-format version. Unknown versions are rejected with a typed reason, never coerced.

context.description: Session/identity context captured at turn start. Optional: degraded turns may omit it entirely.

status.description: ok = normal completion; error = the turn ended in an error state; blocked = a blocking_issue stopped the turn (renderer: session_log_renderer.py line ~886).

ended_by.description: What ended the turn, when known (e.g. the lifecycle event name). Open vocabulary; null when the producer cannot attribute it.

decisions.description: Deferred detail (CAWS-HARNESS-TELEMETRY-ADAPTER-001): the vendored renderer may populate it; adapter folds leave it absent for this slice. Shape is renderer-owned.

next_action.description: Deferred detail: renderer-populated; adapter folds leave it absent for this slice.

blocking_issue.description: Deferred detail: renderer-populated; a non-null value pairs with status 'blocked'.

refs.description: Deferred detail: file/search/command/agent/artifact references. Structure is renderer-owned.

kind.description: Entry class, e.g. 'tool_call' or 'reasoning'. Per-kind payload fields (output, command, file, text, ...) are renderer-owned and intentionally unpinned here.
